tax.text: Huffman voted against and condemned the 2025 Republican reconciliation law for cutting Medicaid and food assistance to fund tax cuts.
tax.quote: Millions of Americans will have their health care and food assistance taken away.

wages.text: He voted to raise the federal minimum wage to $15 per hour.
wages.quote: Representative Jared Huffman (D-San Rafael) voted to pass H.R. 582, the Raise the Wage Act, legislation that gradually increases the federal minimum wage from $7.25 an hour to $15 an hour by 2025

debt.text: Huffman demanded Republicans abandon efforts to cut Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid benefits.
debt.quote: Every American should be able to access the high-quality health care and dignified retirement they deserve

schools.text: He led an effort to withdraw an executive order prioritizing voucher funding for private and charter schools.
schools.quote: The federal government should be investing in robust funding to support and strengthen our public schools rather than redirecting resources to unaccountable, privately run secular and religious schools

immigration.text: Huffman was an original cosponsor of comprehensive immigration reform creating a path to citizenship for undocumented immigrants.
immigration.quote: A bill that has already won bipartisan support is our best opportunity to break this logjam and fix this broken immigration system.

guns.text: Huffman backs universal background checks and other gun-control measures, calling gun violence a uniquely American epidemic.
guns.quote: We have a gun violence epidemic in our country, a crisis that is uniquely American.

abortion.text: Huffman opposes restrictions on abortion and pledges to defend reproductive rights.
abortion.quote: I am renewing my commitment to ensure that women's rights are always treated as human rights.

gender.text: Huffman voted for the Equality Act to bar discrimination based on gender identity and sexual orientation.
gender.quote: I'm glad today to vote for the Equality Act to protect LGBTQ Americans from legal discrimination

cannabis.text: Huffman voted for the MORE Act to end federal marijuana prohibition and supports legalization.
cannabis.quote: Today Congress took an important step to eliminate one of the many harmful repercussions of federal marijuana prohibition

health.text: Huffman cosponsors Medicare for All and supports a universal, single-payer health care system.
health.quote: It is time for the United States to join the standard set by all other industrialized countries and create a universal, single-payer healthcare system.

energy.text: Huffman calls climate change the top priority and pushes to end fossil fuel use and accelerate clean energy.
energy.quote: Addressing climate change is the greatest imperative of our time.

voting.text: Huffman voted for sweeping voting-rights legislation to expand and protect access to the ballot.
voting.quote: Democracy is at its strongest when voting is accessible, special-interest money is eradicated, and elected officials are held accountable.

safety.text: Her campaign platform calls for stronger deterrents and support for law enforcement.
safety.quote: Shield the Vulnerable +Stop the Predators +Stronger Deterrents +Support Law Enforcement

immigration.text: She supports a faster legal-immigration process alongside measures intended to discourage illegal immigration.
immigration.quote: Reward legal immigration with a more efficient process and continue to implement measures that highly discourage illegal immigration.
